list_structure_acts.title: Read a structure's act log
list_structure_acts.description: One structure's record of what its leadership did, newest first. scope=subtree widens it to the structure's descendant closure, which an externally supplied resolver walks.

args.description: The structure whose log to read.
structure for this structure alone, or subtree for it and its descendants. Empty means structure.
Narrow to one filter class. Empty means every class.
How many entries to return, capped at 500. Empty means 500.

count_structure_acts.title: Tally a structure's acts by class
count_structure_acts.description: The per-class tally and its total, over one query so the counts sum to what a concurrent listing would see. Every declared class appears, including the ones at zero.

args.description: The structure whose log to tally.
structure or subtree, as on the listing.
Count only acts at or after this RFC 3339 instant. Empty means all time.

list_custody_events.title: Read the organization's custody log
list_custody_events.description: Everything done to the organization's data as data, newest first.

args.description: Narrow to one filter chip. Empty means every chip.
How many entries to return, capped at 500. Empty means 500.

count_custody_events.title: Tally the custody log by chip
count_custody_events.description: The per-chip tally and its total, for the act log's reason. Every declared chip appears, including the ones at zero.

args.description: Count only events at or after this RFC 3339 instant. Empty means all time.

get_export_job.title: Read one export job
get_export_job.description: Deliberately unscoped: it must not be reachable without a check on the row it returns, which is the mounting process's job.

args.description: The job to read.

list_organization_exports.title: List the organization's export jobs
list_organization_exports.description: Organization-scoped jobs only. The two export policies are never one with an or, so an actor's own exports are a separate address.

list_actor_exports.title: List an actor's own export jobs
list_actor_exports.description: Readable only by the actor the jobs are about. The caller comes from the session rather than the address, so a caller naming someone else is refused instead of answered.

args.description: Whose export jobs to list.
The authenticated caller, compared against actorID.

list_contact_reads.title: List who read an actor's contact details
list_contact_reads.description: The subject's own view, readable only by them. Undecorated: operator, role and structure names live on other objects and are composed by whatever mounts this.

args.description: Whose contact reads to list.
The authenticated caller, compared against actorID.

get_consent_version_in_force.title: Read the consent version currently in force
get_consent_version_in_force.description: The greatest published_at with no superseded_at, within one scope and language. Nothing published there is a not-found, which is an ordinary state.

args.description: Which half of the sheet.
Which language rendering.

get_consent_version.title: Read one consent version
get_consent_version.description: Reads back the exact wording a consent record pins, whether or not it is still in force.

args.description: The version to read.

create_consent_version.title: Draft a consent version
create_consent_version.description: Creates an unpublished version. The publication fields are not accepted from a caller: accepting them would let one mint text already in force, naming a publisher who never published.

args.description: The version to draft.

publish_consent_version.title: Publish a consent version
publish_consent_version.description: Brings one version into force and supersedes whichever held that scope and language, atomically. publishedBy is the authenticated caller and never a body field: an act that creates authority names who did it.

args.description: The version to publish.
The authenticated caller, recorded as the publisher.
